title: Cold rebuild: every page, authenticated
summary: Export the open tickets from a paginated API with a bearer token, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Calling REST APIs* you read every page of the ticket API with a token. Do it again from memory: the same check,
**no hints, no solution**. This check and the boss prove the module.

steps.prompt: Why does reading a token with `Get-Content -Raw` alone often fail in an `Authorization` header?
options: The file's trailing newline ends up in the header value, which is not allowed
steps.explain: `-Raw` keeps the whole file, including the final line break. `.Trim()` (or reading without `-Raw`) removes it.
